title: Portuguese Stew with Tofu
description: A hearty and comforting stew inspired by Portuguese cuisine, featuring tender tofu and a rich vegetable broth.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrots, and tofu. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the tomatoes, vegetable broth, red wine, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
